name: John Warner

offices.t: United States Secretary of the Navy

summary: John William Warner III (February 18, 1927 – May 25, 2021) was an American politician and lawyer who served as a United States senator from Virginia from 1979 to 2009. A member of the Republican Party, he previously served as the U.S. secretary of the Navy from 1972 to 1974. Warner is both the longest serving Republican Senator from Virginia, and the second longest serving Senator from Virginia behind Democrat Harry F. Byrd.
